BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current M l - 1 Limited Manufacturing/Business Park District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 24-D in the area bounded by:

       East 99"' Street; a line 788.46 feet east of South Cottage Grove Avenue as measured along
       the south line of East 99'*' Street; a line 60 feet south of and parallel to East 99"^ Street; and
       South Cottage Grove Avenue

to those of a C3-1, Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 9901 South Cottage Grove Avenue/801 - 875 East 99th Street

                              SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                                     TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
                       9901 South Cottage Grove Avenue/801 - 875 East 99"^ Street
                                          From Ml-1 toC3-l


The Project

The Property is currently used as a driveway access road. The Applicant proposes to establish consistent
zoning with the remainder of its property immediately adjacent to the south. The property will serve as
an accessory drive-way to the improvements on the zoning lot to the south.

The Site

The subject property consists of 47,654 square feet, and is currently used as a driveway access road. The
land use in the immediate area consists of industrial uses to the south of East 99'*^ Street and Commercial
and Residential uses north of East 99''' Street with building heights from one to three stories.

Lot Area:                       47,654 square feet

FAR:                             1.2

Floor Area:                      57,184.80 square feet

MLA:                            N/A

Height:                          38 feet maximum

Setbacks (existing): N/A

* Any proposed future development will comply with the Air Quality Ordinance as applicable per
Section 17-9-0117 ofthe Chicago Zoning Ordinance.

* Applicant must satisfy the Industrial Corridor zoning map amendment process and considerations, as
applicable, per Section 17-13-0400 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance. These consideration factors
include:

          17-13-0403-A the size of the district: 329.4 acres

          17-13-0403-B the number of existin^ firms and employees that would be affected: nono

          I7-I3-0403-C recent and planned public and private investinents within the district: As of
          February 2020, there were 31 businesses located in the district. The dislrict is in the Stony
          Island/Burnside, Lake Calumet Industrial Corridor TIF Dislrict, and is also localed wiihin
          Enterprise Zone 3. Certain Cily-owned sites allow for cost-effective land acquisition for
          deveiopment projecis that could deliver significant job creation.           '.,
                                                   FINAL FOR PUBLICATION
17-13-0403-D the potential of the district to support additional industrial uses and increased
manufacturing empIoyment: As of February 2020, there were 1222 jobs located in the district.
Given the City owned lots available for cost-effective developmenl, the TIF, Enterprise Zone,
benefits likely through Chicago's Opportunity Zones, significanl access to transportation, and
availability of a highly-skilled workforce, the district has significant potential to support
additional industrial uses and manufacturing employmenl and this rezoning request furthers
those goals.

17-13-0403-E the proporlion of land in the dislrict currently devoted to industrial uses: As of
October 2018, 27% of the companies in the district are food manufacturers and this is growing.
In 2017, approximalely 27% of the jobs in the district were related to the production of goods.

I7-13-0403-F the proportion of land in the districl currently devoted to non-manufacturing
uses: As of October 2018, 23% of the companies in the district are transportation, distribution
and logistics companies, and the warehousing and distribution uses are growing rapidly given
proximity to transit. In 2017, approximalely 70%o of the jobs in the district were industrial
related, services, and 3% were related to office and retail uses.

17-13-0403-G the area's importance lo the city as an industrial dislrict: The Burnside Industrial
Dislrict is a solid, contributing employment area ofthe City, and the current rezoning request to
C3 allows for very similar and compatible uses as the cuiTcnt M l , while also allowing for
creation of jobs which are consistent with the trend of employment in the area.
